text: Maakan Annasara'en an Nulaaɗo : "Wata on feƴƴintin e kon ko yamiraɗon jokkugol goonga, wata on feƴintin mawningol ɓen ɓe yamiraɗon mawninnde -wano Annabaaɓe ɓen- haa waɗtonɓe reweteeɓe ; wano gerduɗon e fii Iisaa ɓiɗɗo Maryama on, jokkituɗon adinooɓe on e majjere nde ɓe majjinno yimɓe ɗuuɗɓe, ɓe majji laawol goonga ngol.
